name: iPayX
verdict: No customer OAuth: your agent calls iPayX with your own bearer token on a paid API plan, with no per-customer approval or review. About 1-3 days.
needGuide: No — pick an API plan, store your token server-side and call it.

auth.detail: iPayX is an FX forensic-audit service (FINTRAC-registered MSB per its site), not a system holding the user's accounts. REST: POST https://api.ipayx.ai/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine with a Bearer token. MCP server: https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp (streamable HTTP) with tools fx_audit, calcul_spread, score_fx, rapport_forensique and verify_integrity; MCP manifest at /.well-known/mcp.json and OpenAPI 3.1 at /.well-known/openapi.json. No OAuth documented. Bank data comes from PDF/CSV upload or from Plaid (US/Canada) on the service side.

effort.timeToFirstTest: under 30 min once you have a token (MCP endpoint or one REST call)

approval.gate: None documented; access appears to be by paid API plan. There is no per-customer approval or marketplace review because your agent calls iPayX with your own token.

scopes.why: No scope model documented; one token covers the API and MCP tools.
scopes.summary: No scope model documented; one token covers the audit API and MCP tools.

cost: API plans from $99/month; Forensic Pack from $297 (per the site)
prerequisites: Account and owner: Whoever owns the iPayX account and billing (use a company account); a developer to store the Bearer token as a secret.
Where you register: Site → Pricing → API plans (from $99/month) → obtain Bearer token. How keys are issued is not described in the pages read.
Cost: API plans from $99/month; Forensic Pack from $297 (per the site)

registerAt.path: Site → Pricing → API plans (from $99/month) → obtain Bearer token. How keys are issued is not described in the pages read.

steps.do: Choose an API plan on the Pricing page and create or request a Bearer token
Store the token in a secrets manager; never ship it to the browser
Call POST /functions/v1/fx-audit-engine with a sample rate or statement and check the score and markup percentage
Optionally register https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp as an MCP server in your agent and test the five tools
Review data-handling terms (PIPEDA/FINTRAC claims) before sending customer statements
Add error handling and usage metering against your plan limits

roles.team: Whoever owns the iPayX account and billing (use a company account); a developer to store the Bearer token as a secret.
roles.customer: No customer-side OAuth. If your flow uses Plaid-backed bank connection, the end user authorizes through Plaid Link; otherwise the customer's finance staff supply statements or CSV files.

testing: The site has a Demo page; whether sandbox or test tokens exist is not stated.
Test through the MCP server with sample rates and statements.

blockers.problem: Key issuance and sandbox are not documented publicly
blockers.fix: Contact iPayX before planning a launch.
Confirm retention and sub-processors (the site names GPT-4o, DeepSeek and Twelve Data) before use.

automation.agentCan: Call the API or MCP tools, write wrappers and tests, and draft the vendor due-diligence questions.
automation.humanMust: Sign up and pay for a plan, accept terms, vendor due diligence, and handle any customer consent for uploading statements.

uncertain: How tokens are issued, rate limits, sandbox availability, SLA, and whether /docs exists (the docs URL returned only marketing metadata).
Claims come from the vendor's own llms.txt and are unaudited.
